title: Kissed Irish Chicken Wrap
description: Bitter, snappy, and light, this Irish dish combines the flavors of enchilada sauce, marinated chicken, and fresh herbs.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together 1 cup of buttermilk, 1 tablespoon of Dijon mustard, 1 teaspoon of dried thyme, and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
Add the marinade to the chicken breasts and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches a safe internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Warm large flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spoon about 1/4 cup of enchilada sauce down the center of each tortilla, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Add a grilled chicken breast to each tortilla, followed by a sprinkle of chopped fresh parsley and dill.
Drizzle the Irish sour cream over the top of each wrap, then fold the bottom edge up over the filling and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional fresh herbs if desired.
